instruction: Candid documentary photograph, eye-level medium full shot. Inside a judo dojo with wooden wall paneling and large windows, the young man in the white judo gi (R2) on the left and the woman in the blue judo gi (R1) on the right engage in a judo sparring match. They face each other in a dynamic stance, gripping each other's collars and sleeves to gain leverage. In the background, a blurred bystander in a white gi sits quietly on the mat. Soft, even indoor lighting illuminates the training area, casting gentle shadows.
